question.purpose: Quiz question text, distinct from Headline.

label.purpose: Metadata and category tags, tracked uppercase.

statsNum.purpose: Any gamified counter — XP, streak, accuracy.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #0e4471; color: #ffffff; border: 2px solid #0e4471; border-radius: 24px; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; transition: opacity 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: 0.85; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Gamification CTA Button
components.description: Reward-flavored CTA with a pressable bottom border.
components.css: .ds-btn-gamification { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #fda864; color: #753c00; border: none; border-bottom: 4px solid #8f4e0f; border-radius: 24px; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; color: #0e4471; border: 2px solid #0e4471; border-radius: 24px; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; }

components.name: Answer Card — Selected
components.description: Quiz answer option in the selected, unverified state.
components.css: .ds-answer-card { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; min-height: 60px; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: #121c2a; } .ds-answer-selected { border: 2px solid #0e4471; background: #d1e4ff; }

components.name: Answer Card — Correct
components.description: Quiz answer option revealed as correct.
components.css: .ds-answer-card { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; min-height: 60px; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; } .ds-answer-correct { border: 2px solid #004e10; background: #a3f69c; color: #005312; }

components.name: Lesson Node — Available
components.description: Circular map node for a navigable, not-yet-started lesson.
components.css: .ds-lesson-node { width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 32px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-node-available { background: #f8f9ff; border: 2px solid #0e4471; }

components.name: Checkpoint Node
components.description: Diamond (45°-rotated square) marking a major stop on the learning map.
components.css: .ds-checkpoint { width: 80px; height: 80px; border-radius: 16px; background: #0e4471; border: 2px solid #0e4471; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-checkpoint-icon { transform: rotate(-45deg); color: #ffffff; }

narrative.overview: ArqLearn's mobile app merges the professional precision of architectural practice with the dopamine-driven engagement of gamified learning. The personality is educational and authoritative, but never dry — it stays motivating for students grinding a daily streak. The visual style hybridizes Modern Minimalism and Technical Brutalism: heavy whitespace and clean layouts, punctuated by Drafting Accents — thin technical strokes, monospaced numerals, and a subtle blueprint-grid tone. Unlike typical gamified apps that lean into soft, bubbly shapes, this system stays sharp and structured on purpose.
keyCharacteristics: Sharp, structured geometry — never bubbly or soft-gamified
Flat by default: depth comes from tonal fills and 1–2px borders, not shadows
One color per job: blue = learning/navigation, orange = gamification, green = success — never mixed
Monospaced numerals (JetBrains Mono) for anything that counts (XP, streak, stats)

rules.name: The One Job Per Color Rule
rules.body: Blue is structural/navigational, orange is exclusively gamification reward, green is exclusively success/validation. A card never borrows orange or green for anything but their assigned job.

rules.name: The Mono-Counts Rule
rules.body: Anything the user is meant to watch go up (XP, streak days, accuracy %) renders in statsNum (JetBrains Mono Bold), never in Hanken Grotesk or Inter.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. The only escapes are a transient overlay like Toast, and the gamification CTA's heavier bottom border to read as pressable.

dos: Do keep orange strictly to XP/streak/reward surfaces.
Do pair every color-coded correct/incorrect state with a distinct icon, never color alone.
Do use statsNum (JetBrains Mono Bold) for every counter the user watches change.
Do keep lesson-map nodes flat (border + fill only) — the diamond checkpoint is the one allowed shape break.
donts: Don't add shadowColor/elevation to a resting surface.
Don't wire a Pressable inside a ScrollView through the native disabled prop — it traps Android's scroll gesture.
Don't silently reconcile the button-radius gap between mobile (24px) and the shared spec (12px) by copying one value over the other without a design decision.
